name: vendor_failure
statement: One or two vendors degraded and dragged the site average down.
test_sql: select vendor, count(*) n, 100.0*count(*) filter (where is_ontime_15)/count(*) ota from mis.trips where office='Cedar Ridge Office' and business_unit='vanta-Aus' and trip_date='2026-07-21' group by 1
reasoning: All five vendors fell into a 7-point band. A vendor-specific failure would show one or two outliers against healthy peers, not uniform degradation.

name: electrification_cost
statement: vanta-Aus is shifting to electric vehicles, and EVs are slower on these routes.
test_sql: select fuel_type, date_trunc('month',trip_date) m, 100.0*count(*) filter (where is_ontime_15)/count(*) ota from mis.trips where business_unit='vanta-Aus' group by 1,2
reasoning: Diesel and electric decline in lockstep, 89.5 to 81.7 against 89.3 to 81.1. The orbit-Slc control shows electric at 72.5% against diesel at 71.7%, so there is no fuel-type penalty anywhere in the fleet.

name: schedule_lag
statement: Actual journey times degraded and the planning did not follow.
test_sql: select date_trunc('month',trip_date) m, avg((actual_end-actual_start)/60.0)/avg(traveled_km) actual_min_per_km, avg((planned_end-planned_start)/60.0)/avg(planned_km) planned_min_per_km from mis.trips where business_unit='vanta-Aus' and planned_km>0 and traveled_km>0 group by 1
reasoning: Actual minutes per km rose 10.5% while planned minutes per km rose only 3.4%. Journeys genuinely got slower and the schedule absorbed less than a third of the change.

name: operational_improvement
statement: Santa Clara improved its operations and punctuality followed.
test_sql: select case when trip_date<'2026-07-19' then 'before' else 'after' end p, avg((planned_end-planned_start)/60.0) planned_min, avg((actual_end-actual_start)/60.0) actual_min, count(distinct actual_cab_registration) cabs from mis.trips where office='Santa Clara Office' and trip_date>='2026-07-01' group by 1
reasoning: Actual journey time rose from 76.4 to 77.0 minutes on 14 fewer cabs. Nothing about the operation improved; only the planned duration changed, by 43%.
